name: Oculus
description: Automated attack-surface mapping and vulnerability orchestration engine. Chains 37 industry-standard offensive tools — ProjectDiscovery stack, ffuf, nuclei, dalfox — into a concurrent, multi-phase execution pipeline spanning the full pentest lifecycle: active and passive discovery, infrastructure mapping, parameter fuzzing, vulnerability scanning, and targeted exploitation. Managed via a FastAPI + React web dashboard with real-time streaming output, session checkpointing for resumable scans, dynamic concurrency scaling, and push notifications. Ships HTML, JSON, and Markdown reports.

name: KAVACH
description: Multi-modal cyber fraud defense platform that breaks the modern attack chain at every stage simultaneously. Three real-time AI shields: Voice Shield analyzes 9 scientific spectral features via librosa to detect deepfake audio in live mic recordings; SIM Guard streams live WebSocket carrier telemetry via IPQualityScore to detect SIM-swap fraud and OTP hijacking; Job Shield runs a multi-layer forensic pipeline querying VirusTotal's 75+ engines, Google Safe Browsing, URLHaus, AbuseIPDB, SecurityTrails, and a heuristic engine in parallel. Dual-LLM forensics via NVIDIA NIM and Groq LLaMA 3.3 70B.

name: PRAXIS
description: AI-native financial simulator where you build a Financial Twin and navigate real-world financial crossroads. At every decision node, a Multi-Agent AI Council of three specialized agents — The Conservator, The Grower, The Behaviorist — independently analyze your scenario then debate each other in a three-phase protocol: independent analysis, cross-examination, and synthesis with a confidence score. Every choice cascades through a 10-year wealth projection and mastery radar. Features a 3D Financial Galaxy in Three.js with orbital physics tied to real-world asset volatility, and live market tickers via Alpha Vantage and CoinGecko.

name: Interceptor
description: Android notification vault with hardware-backed biometric locking and rule-based suppression. Built as a system NotificationListenerService in Kotlin, Interceptor silently captures target app notifications, encrypts them with AES via the Android KeyStore hardware-backed key, and persists them in a Room database — all behind a biometric and credential authentication gate. A ConcurrentHashMap action cache enables quick-reply passthroughs without exposing raw data. Rule builders create suppression schedules by active foreground package and time window, with an optional home-screen widget for vault status.

name: Sentinel
description: AI-driven incident response and operational reliability monorepo. Groups system logs via signature-based deduplication, indexes resolutions using conversational context mapping, queries vector databases for historical outage postmortems, and monitors active host states including CPU load, memory metrics, listener ports, and local container health.

name: ZeroRisk Sentinel
description: Hybrid threat detection platform with a terminal-inspired frontend and Python Flask backend. Drop files, paste URLs, or upload APKs to get YARA scanning, multi-engine malware intelligence, APK permission forensics, and AI-powered threat explanations via Groq. Ships ECharts visualizations and HTML reports.

name: SwipeClean
description: Gamified desktop cleanup engine built on Electron and React 19. Features a Tinder-style swipe interface for rapid folder triage, Live Stack HUD tracking decisions in real time, a physics-based Safe-Undo buffer, PDF thumbnail previews via pdf2pic, and a SQLite-backed session database.

name: Periscope
description: Local network socket monitor and AI cyber-diagnostics desktop utility for Windows. Scans active TCP/UDP connections, applies local risk heuristics to flag suspicious processes, resolves digital signatures asynchronously via a background PowerShell Authenticode worker, maps WHOIS geolocation for external IPs, and streams token-by-token Groq AI analysis inline in the GUI. Compiles to a single 25MB standalone exe.

name: Cura AI
description: Interactive patient simulation and clinical grading platform. The frameworkless Node.js backend routes through a multi-model AI waterfall — Gemini, Groq, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Ollama — with scrypt-hashed credential management and optional Supabase persistence. Evaluates diagnosis submissions against a structured rubric with keyword-mapped offline fallback dialogue and faculty analytics endpoints.

name: VitaLink
description: Empathetic chronic care companion web app. Guides patient routines via AI completion endpoints secured in local storage, with an offline fallback keyword-response engine supporting English, Hindi, and Spanish. Features daily treatment checklists and caregiver safety logs.

name: ShellStack
description: Massive offensive security hub unifying hundreds of tools and 570+ tactical commands for CEH v13 mastery across 20+ integrated modules with an immersive terminal-first interface.

name: CyberForge-Atlas
description: Unified, self-contained offensive intelligence knowledge matrix for fast offensive security research and tool reference.

name: Port Reaper
description: Asynchronous 65,535-port scanner with service fingerprinting, risk assessment scoring, and one-click PDF report export.

name: ReconMaster
description: Unified reconnaissance framework for Kali Linux, chaining 12+ industry-standard tools into a deep recon workflow with guided menu navigation.

name: cyberGuard
description: Advanced password security suite with AES-256 encryption, HaveIBeenPwned breach detection, and a radar-based strength visualization interface.

name: MailGuard
description: Deterministic email security and spam scanner running on a custom backend service. Rule-based scans map urgencies, financial fraud terms, dangerous extensions, and blacklisted domains with locally persisted configuration.

name: AskMeBot
description: Smart Discord AI assistant with slash commands, memory-based conversation context, and integrated image generation capabilities.

name: OSINT Academy
description: Interactive OSINT learning platform with a real-time Google dork generator, comprehensive reconnaissance study guides, and categorized tool references.

name: OSINT-Directory
description: Curated intelligence toolkit with powerful category navigation and keyword search for security professionals and researchers.

name: Keylogger
description: Python-based stealth keyboard monitor demonstrating event-listening patterns and SMTP-based log exfiltration for ethical hacking research and security awareness.
